status_effects.explanation: Locally diminished by irony: impressive in wealth and bearing but shown as self-absorbed and ungenerous toward others' wit.

appraisal_events.evidence: comme si elles avaient été fondues au creuset en un seul lingot humain... duc de Guermantes riait de ses bons mots, mais ne se déridait pas à ceux des autres
appraisal_events.explanation: The narrator's grandiose statue-and-gold-ingot imagery magnifies the duc's wealth and physical bearing, but the closing detail that he laughs only at his own witticisms and not others' quietly deflates this grandeur into self-satisfied hollowness.
